SWFFG.UI.NoModelMatches: No valid model matches that search.
SWFFG.UI.ModelHelp: Choose a model to fill its recorded profile. The ship's name stays editable.
SWFFG.UI.NoManufacturerMatches: No valid manufacturer matches that search.
SWFFG.UI.ManufacturerHelp: Filter models by manufacturer; choosing a model sets both.
SWFFG.UI.RegistrationPlaceholder: Assigned when a model is chosen
SWFFG.UI.NoSpeciesMatches: No valid species matches that search.
SWFFG.UI.NoCareerMatches: No valid career matches that search.
SWFFG.UI.CampaignRulesHelp: Chosen by the GM for this adventure.
SWFFG.UI.ReviewSpeciesAbilities: Review the abilities marked “Apply when relevant” before finishing creation.
SWFFG.UI.SpeciesReviewHelp: The catalogue's species ability shorthand has not been checked against the book. Review the source before applying its effects.
SWFFG.UI.CreateCharacterHelp: Choose every option, or start with a few questions.
SWFFG.UI.BuildEnemyHelp: Choose a role and review an original NPC preset.
SWFFG.UI.FinishCharacterCreationHelp: Spend XP using + XP and the talent trees, review species exceptions and finish starting funds.
SWFFG.UI.PurchaseCharacteristic: Purchase next characteristic rating with XP
SWFFG.UI.DamageHelp: Damage accumulates. A threshold is exceeded only when the current value is greater.
SWFFG.UI.FinishStartingFundsHelp: Roll d100 after the starting loadout is final.
SWFFG.UI.CanvasFootprintHelp: The token badge fills its occupied width and length, with the hull symbol centred inside it. Characters can stand on or board ground vehicles.
SWFFG.UI.FootprintHelp: Use exact dimensions when the craft's published measurements are known. Manual token resizing disables later automatic rescaling for that placed token.
SWFFG.UI.MinionGroupHelp: Enter the wound threshold of one member above. Mark trained group skills on the Skills tab.
SWFFG.UI.SkillsHelp: Click a skill to build and roll its pool
SWFFG.UI.EquipmentHelp: Weapons, armor, gear, and attachments. Drag more from the local compendiums.
SWFFG.UI.NoSummaryRecorded: No summary recorded; open to review.
SWFFG.UI.AbilitiesHelp: Purchased talents, species traits, and other granted abilities appear here with their attached source records.
SWFFG.UI.AdvancementIntro: Build a character. Follow a path.
SWFFG.UI.RefreshTalentGuidance: Refresh owned talent guidance from local library
SWFFG.UI.MissingTalentTree: Add the chart with the private PDF tree importer. A list of talent names alone does not define a valid upgrade path.
SWFFG.UI.MissingSpecialization: Add a specialization or signature ability from the library to see its upgrade paths.
SWFFG.UI.StoryHooksHelp: The rolled categories and source references remain available to the GM and connected tools.
SWFFG.UI.MotivationsHelp: Add as many active or dormant motivations as the character needs. Director of Realms receives their category, guidance and source reference.
SWFFG.UI.NoMotivations: No structured motivations yet. Use Add or drag a motivation reference from the library.
SWFFG.UI.BioNotesPlaceholder: Describe personality, choices and development in your own words.
SWFFG.UI.BioNotesHelp: Freeform notes for the character owner and GM. Add details as the character develops; the background story above stays separate.
SWFFG.UI.TidyBioNotes: Move generated background out of Bio Notes
SWFFG.UI.FooterRulebooks: Independent tooling · Keep the rulebooks at the table
SWFFG.UI.GroupMembersHelp: Link a character and sync to copy their current story scores and motivation. Changes here stay in the group record.
SWFFG.UI.StartingGroupAssetHelp: Choose the party's shared starting ship, base, holocron, or mentor from the enabled campaign line.
SWFFG.UI.FiringArcsHelp: Leave blank to use imported arcs. Enter fore, aft, port, starboard or all; combine arcs with commas. Dorsal and ventral mounts retain their elevation restriction.
SWFFG.UI.ReferenceHelp: This entry is a reference. The source book explains the rule.
SWFFG.UI.BookshelfHelp: This selection filters the catalogue and reference API for GMs and players, starting choices, item drops and future compendium imports. Existing characters and compendium documents are preserved.
SWFFG.UI.IncludeUnreferenced: Include entries without a book reference when filtering
SWFFG.UI.AdditionalSourceTitles: Additional source titles, one per line
SWFFG.UI.BookFilterHelp: Only selected books + no selection shows no book-sourced entries.
SWFFG.UI.NoReferences: No matching references. Check the search and the GM's owned-book selection.
SWFFG.UI.ReferenceHelpLong: Select a result to see its statistics, notes and book page. The catalogue retains the creator's database fields; blank values remain unknown.
SWFFG.UI.RollTablesIntro: Roll with the book in view.
SWFFG.UI.RollTablesHelp: Only tables with checked dice, ranges and result labels are available. Other rules and special outcomes remain in their source book.
SWFFG.UI.RollTableResultHelp: The table supplies the result label. Use the cited page for its explanation and any follow-up roll.
SWFFG.UI.RollTablesNoneHelp: Ask the GM to select the relevant source book in Owned books.
SWFFG.UI.NoLearnedEffects: No matching learned effects. This is not a claim that every ability is automated.
SWFFG.UI.EffectInspectorHelp: Select an actor to inspect recorded effects. Only actors available to this account are listed.
SWFFG.UI.ParaphrasePlaceholder: Record a concise, original rule summary for this item.
SWFFG.UI.StructuredEffectsHelp: Declarative effects only; no scripts or executable text.
SWFFG.UI.AbilitiesJsonHelp: Each ability needs a name; add summary, activation and structured effects when verified.
SWFFG.UI.ReviewFlagsHelp: Remove a flag only after the corresponding source point has been checked.
SWFFG.UI.TalentTreeHelp: Use the source reference and validate the whole tree before saving.
SWFFG.UI.DataReviewHelp: World items and actor-owned talents, specializations and equipment appear here when they have missing or unverified data.
SWFFG.UI.ImpairmentHelp: An impairment adds one setback die to the relevant checks until repaired.
SWFFG.UI.DamageAppearanceHelp: DoR shows sparks for damaged droids and blood for damaged actors that bleed. Override this for a character that does not bleed.
SWFFG.UI.AdvancementHelp: Purchase connected talents with available XP. Structured passive effects marked Auto feed the dice pool; use the cited book for every node whose wording is not supplied by a private library.
SWFFG.UI.HomebrewAdvancementHelp: Set homebrew starting statistics, skills, abilities, XP and equipment manually. The GM completes this setup using the Homebrew identity panel above.
SWFFG.UI.DataReviewTitle: STAR WARS FFG / GM DATA REVIEW
SWFFG.UI.FooterUnofficial: Unofficial fan system · Keep the rulebooks at the table
SWFFG.UI.AttachAbilityHelp: Attach this ability to an eligible owned specialization. Its base node unlocks after a matching bottom-row talent is learned.
SWFFG.UI.AttachSpecializationHelp: Attach this specialization to a character to view and purchase its connected talents.
SWFFG.UI.SpeciesDetailsReview: Species ability details still require a book check; the catalogue's Special field is shorthand only.
SWFFG.UI.SummaryHelp: Summary from recorded fields; consult the book for descriptions and effects.
SWFFG.UI.RollTablesTitle: STAR WARS FFG / REVIEWED ROLL TABLES
SWFFG.UI.SupportStartHelp: Declare intent, review the dice pool, roll, agree the result, then apply reviewed changes. Recorded conditions and narrative choices do not silently apply every mechanical effect.
SWFFG.UI.DiagnosticHelp: Review the complete export below. It contains versions, two integration states and document counts. It excludes names, world IDs, settings, source notes, chat content, URLs and credentials. Nothing is uploaded.
SWFFG.UI.SupportLimitsHelp: These packaged guides open as Markdown documents. Books remain the authority for rules. A printed-chart check validates the graph; it does not certify every effect.
SWFFG.UI.SessionConsoleHelp: These controls persist world state. The GM manages Destiny flips for the table.
SWFFG.UI.DefaultSheetThemeHint: Automatic matches each character's creation rules and uses the campaign's first enabled ruleset for vehicles and groups. A sheet's own theme control can override this setting.
SWFFG.UI.FoundryInterfaceThemeHint: Style the space backdrop, sidebar, chat, combat tracker, journals, windows, scene controls, player list and hotbar. Automatic follows the first enabled campaign ruleset; choose a scheme here to override it.
SWFFG.UI.CompactDiceTray: Vassoio dadi compatto accanto alla chat
SWFFG.UI.CompactDiceTrayHint: Show a minimal seven-die pool beside the chat bar. It uses the active chat visibility button for public, GM, blind or self rolls.
SWFFG.UI.TransactionAuthorityHint: Select the single GM tab that processes XP, turn, crew and tabletop transactions.
SWFFG.UI.GmSourceKeyHint: Keep a private backup to unlock encrypted source notes on another GM browser.
SWFFG.UI.GmSourceLibraryHint: Search imported descriptions, abilities and rules in this GM browser.
SWFFG.UI.CampaignRulesHint: Enable one or more rule lines, combine their story mechanics, and lock completed character origins when play begins.
SWFFG.UI.PrivateLibraryHint: Populate world compendiums from a local Star Wars FFG library JSON.
SWFFG.UI.ExternalToolsRules: Strumenti esterni e regole della comunità
SWFFG.UI.ExternalToolsHint: Review a versioned interchange package from a character builder or community-rules site.
SWFFG.UI.ImportAdversariesHint: Read a local swa.stoogoff.com JSON export into this world's actor compendium.
SWFFG.UI.HelpRulesCoverageHint: Quick starts, automation limits, learned effects and privacy-safe diagnostics.
SWFFG.UI.AltitudeShadowsHint: Project elevated actor artwork onto level surfaces and lower actors. Disable on this device if preferred.
SWFFG.UI.AllowHomebrewIdentitiesHint: GM override: let actor owners use custom species, careers, vehicle models and manufacturers. Database search remains available. Custom entries retain the current stats for manual setup and GM review; character-creation locks still apply.

SWFFG.UI.UnlockBaseAbilityHelp: Learn a marked bottom-row talent to unlock the base ability
SWFFG.UI.SpeciesSummaryHelp: Summary from recorded fields; consult the species source for full creation rules.
SWFFG.UI.ReviewItemsSelect: review items · select one to edit
SWFFG.UI.GearQuantitiesHelp: Gear quantities below are calculated from recorded gains and uses.
SWFFG.UI.CompoundResultBookHelp: Consult the book for this compound result.
SWFFG.UI.HomebrewPendingStatus: Current stats are retained for manual setup. The GM must review characteristics, skills, abilities and resources before completing setup.
SWFFG.UI.HomebrewReviewedStatus: The GM has reviewed the entered setup. Use these recorded values; custom names do not grant additional rules.
SWFFG.UI.OnboardingRememberThisBookshelf: Remember this bookshelf in this browser for future worlds
SWFFG.UI.OnboardingYourBooksYourCampaign: Your books. Your campaign. One table.
SWFFG.UI.OnboardingPlayEdgeOfTheEmpireAg: Play Edge of the Empire, Age of Rebellion and Force and Destiny, separately or together. Foundry's scenes, actors and permissions work as usual; the system adds narrative dice, character creation and tabletop tools.
SWFFG.UI.OnboardingKeepTheBooksAtTheTabl: Keep the books at the table
SWFFG.UI.OnboardingFirstChooseTheBooksAv: First choose the books available to this campaign. The selection is saved in this world and filters references and new character choices for everyone. Existing characters are preserved.
SWFFG.UI.OnboardingYourGMChoosesTheCampa: Your GM chooses the campaign's books and rules. The next step offers a short tour of the added controls.
SWFFG.UI.OnboardingChooseTheBooksYouOwnO: Choose the books you own or are authorised to use for this campaign. This changes reference availability, not the enabled rulesets.
SWFFG.UI.OnboardingBooksIsRememberedInTh: books is remembered in this browser.
SWFFG.UI.OnboardingIncludeRecordsThatHav: Include records that have no book reference
SWFFG.UI.OnboardingWithOnlySelectedBooks: With “Only selected books”, an empty selection hides all book-sourced entries. Remembered books stay in this browser on this Foundry address; they are not uploaded or shared with other servers. You can change the world selection later in Owned books.
SWFFG.UI.OnboardingFamiliarFoundryAFewNe: Familiar Foundry. A few new controls.
SWFFG.UI.OnboardingTheOptionalTourHighli: The optional tour highlights narrative dice, character and vehicle sheets, range tools, combat, journals and help. It won't roll dice or change a character.
SWFFG.UI.OnboardingExitAnyTimeReplayOrRe: Exit any time. Replay or resume from
